title: From Amaliqa to Houthis, here are main armed groups fighting in Yemen
gist: Yemen's Saudi-backed government announced a major offensive on Oct. 4, 2026 to retake Houthi-seized Red Sea coastal areas and Sanaa, claiming the recapture of Mokha and the Bab el-Mandeb area, which the Houthis deny. The government side is a loose conglomerate of southern, ex-UAE-affiliated, Islamist and other groups, while the Iran-backed Houthis remain largely unified and are pressing toward encircling Taiz.

insights.speaker: Adam Lucente
insights.so_what: Marib is Yemen's energy heartland; Houthi pressure there and on Taiz signals the government counteroffensive is not one-directional.
